result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: the restaurant metadata line under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card appears crowded and partially overlapping, making the details hard to read.

issues.description: The metadata text under "Tokumaru Ramen Bar" is visually jammed together, with the delivery time/fee and cuisine information appearing to overlap or run into each other near the rating area.
issues.suggestion: Reflow the card footer so the metadata has more spacing, wraps cleanly onto separate lines if needed, or uses a more compact layout to avoid text collision.
